reason: Twelve fixed-query files give declarative, source-routed answers with appropriate event and financial-state limits. Two files restate questions and instruct a future reader to answer from sources, so they do not answer the campaign's fixed Q1 and Q2 despite having valid routes.
required_changes: In /tmp/adyen-c61/api-explorer-tokenization-webhooks-latest-overview-queries.md, replace both prompt-only Q1/Q2 entries with declarative answers. Q1 should identify the incoming Tokenization webhooks v1 catalog and its four POST token lifecycle event routes (alreadyExisting, created, disabled, updated). Q2 should state that the overview has names/summaries only and supplies no event payload, receiver acknowledgement, delivery mechanics, or payment outcome contract. Retain the canonical source wikilink, URL and raw locators.

In /tmp/adyen-c61/api-explorer-managed-risk-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-managedrisk-rollingreserve-lifted-queries.md, replace both prompt-only Q1/Q2 entries with declarative answers. Q1 should state Adyen sends the incoming event when it lifts a rolling reserve policy from an account holder's payouts; required data/accountHolderId/environment/type and optional balancePlatform/creationDate/timestamp must be scoped to their table locations, with example-only data.id distinguished. Q2 should state any HTTP 2xx accepts receiver delivery but does not establish a reserve-release amount, executed payout, or bank receipt; the raw gives no delivery/order/retry/deduplication/signature rule.
